description: This file provides utility functions for sanitizing untrusted input strings to prevent injection in prompts and for wrapping prompt data blocks with additional metadata. It addresses security concerns related to untrusted directory names and strings embedded into Large Language Model (LLM) prompts, by removing control and formatting characters and properly escaping HTML special characters.

methods.name: export function sanitizeForPromptLiteral(value: string): string { sanitizeForPromptLiteral
methods.description: Sanitizes a string by removing Unicode control (Cc) and format (Cf) characters, as well as line/paragraph separators (U+2028, U+2029), to prevent injection and structural issues when embedding the string into an LLM prompt.

methods.name: export function wrapUntrustedPromptDataBlock(params: { wrapUntrustedPromptDataBlock
methods.description: Prepares a block of untrusted text for embedding in a prompt by normalizing line breaks, sanitizing lines, trimming, optionally limiting length, escaping HTML characters, and wrapping with labels.
